statement: KV cache reuse for recurring context (RAG documents, system prompts) can eliminate most re-encoding cost, but naive reuse causes large accuracy drops that require explicit architectural repair. KVLink shows PromptCache-style naive reuse suffers up to ~35% relative accuracy loss because independently encoded documents lose cross-document dependencies and RoPE positions; positional re-encoding (store without RoPE, re-apply global rotations) plus trainable link tokens recover most of the gap to the fine-tuned full-concatenation upper bound, reducing TTFT by 85-96%. LMCache provides the systems substrate (chunk-level transfer, async loading, 400 Gbps CPU bandwidth vs vLLM's 88 Gbps) that makes reuse practical at enterprise scale. The accuracy repair is algorithmic (KVLink); the deployment gain is systemic (LMCache) — both are needed and they are orthogonal.
